title: Ordinary scalar balancing and pullback square
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings in Type(u+1), phi:A -> B a ring homomorphism and f:Z -> W a scheme morphism in universe u. On each small etale site let E be sheafified sectionwise scalar extension, U exact scalar restriction, and S=U(1_B). The ordinary balancing map b_M:M tensor_A S -> U(E M) is the unit of E adjoint to U, followed by the lax tensorator of U and its image of the right unitor [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. It is invertible without flatness. Let chi:f_A^{-1} U ~= U f_B^{-1} be the specified restriction/pullback iso [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons], e:f_B^{-1}E ~= E f_A^{-1} the scalar/pullback conjugate [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data], and k:f_A^{-1}S_W ~= S_Z the composite of chi on the B-unit and U of the inverse monoidal unit iso. For every A-module sheaf M on W, f_A^{-1}(b_M) ; chi_(E M) ; U(e_M) equals delta_(M,S_W) ; (id tensor k) ; b_(f_A^{-1} M), where delta is ordinary inverse-image comonoidality.

proof.text: Restriction preserves sheafification by its coextension adjunction. The generic sheafified unit-projection theorem and the module balancing isomorphism prove b_M invertible.

The sectionwise direct-image/restriction identity is monoidal. Conjugating under the composite monoidal adjunctions makes e monoidal. Iterated mate identities and the restriction/coextension triangles identify the scalar-adjunction mate of e inverse with chi.

Apply the generic compatibility of unit projections with a monoidal base-change square. Its coefficient map is chi on the B-unit followed by U of the comonoidal unit map, hence k. This is exactly the displayed square.

theorem scalarSheafTensorPullback_square
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W)
    (M : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map (scalarSheafTensorMap φ W M) ≫
        (upperStarRestrictScalarsIsoSheaf φ f).hom.app
          ((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ W).obj M) ≫
        (Sheaf.restrictScalars Z.smallEtaleTopology φ).map
          ((scalarSheafPullbackIso φ f).hom.app M) =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) M
          (scalarCoefficientSheaf φ W) ≫
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj M ◁
          (scalarCoefficientSheafPullbackIso φ f).hom) ≫
        scalarSheafTensorMap φ Z ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj M)
